title: Victoria Craft Beer and Distillery Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Join a fun group and enjoy a 3.5 hour tour of Canadian craft beverages departing from downtown Victoria. You'll visit two breweries and one distillery. Your trip includes round-trip transportation, all of your tastings and a behind-the-scenes look at one of our stops.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
